script_text: THE COSMIC MIRROR SUDDENLY FRACTURES, AND MERCURY RETROGRADE WHISPERS FROM THE SHADOWS. Mercury retrograde, ruler of Gemini (Air), moves backward through the zodiac for three weeks, altering thought, communication, and technology. As its energy slows, reflection replaces action, urging review over launch. The retrograde squares Neptune in the 12th House, fogging intuition, while a sextile to Uranus in the 11th sparks group insights. Romance may stall for 5th House planets, yet a trine to Venus in the 7th revives connections. Career pauses when Mercury opposes Jupiter in the 9th, expanding long-term vision. This retrograde invites a replay of old communication patterns, tied to the North Node and Chiron's wound in speech. Healing emerges when we pause, listen, and rewrite the stories we tell. Triple-check messages, delay signing contracts, and use the pause to review rather than initiate. Comment your sign to see how this transit touches your natal chart.
